items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: I got a call from Eddie Condon to work his saloon, as a soloist. Actually it was a duo with Buzzy Drootin on drums and myself.

ctx.x: Did you find a point growing up that, you started to think about this as a career?

Yeah, when I started doing lousy in high school. After, maybe I was about fifteen, sixteen, I’d still been studying piano but my jazz influence came into me through my father, who loved jazz music, could have been a musician, wasn’t. Had all the instincts. And he used to take me to jazz concerts. I was just talking about that to someone earlier. The first concert I attended was at Carnegie Hall. Eddie Condon had a big, massive jazz party, right on stage there. He had four pianos, four grand pianos, four basses,…
